timing_scope: Existing max-rank overall five-round mean is preserved. Individual rows are MPI maxima of each complete local round interval, including vector reset, callbacks and ending barrier. Their arithmetic mean is a separate statistic; post-timer reductions/printing are excluded from the overall timer.
preparation_probe_scope: Single-rank host-observed call intervals, including any implicit library synchronization, not isolated GPU kernel timings.
memory_scope: Full-process GNU time host RSS peak and rounded phase GPU observations, not continuous GPU peaks.
